notes: Both modes share resident weights and use isolated bounded request sessions.

The all-exact lane freezes tiled source-F16 plus exact global and context-qualified exact SWA attention. The shipping lane freezes gfx1151 compensated source-F16 plus online global/SWA attention; both freeze the same exact grouped-down and dense/shared routes.
Teacher forcing feeds baseline-route top-1 IDs to both routes and compares full logits.
Complete free-running IDs are reported, while KL/top-1 thresholds remain authoritative.
AR decode uses the identical exact c=1 route in both modes.
performance_claim_scope: same-owner Laguna shipping_control versus prefill_350_candidate over all ten canonical category prompts at h16/h32; model load excluded; retained full-model performance gate
